headline: Power Backup Report for Harris County
summary: Homes in Harris County face a high outlook. They may see a long outage of 12 hours or more about once every 4 years. This comes from 8 years of records since 2018. In July 2024, 91% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 29 hours without power. In May 2024, 16% of homes in the county lost power. The longest-waiting tenth faced about 63 hours without power. One Core lasts about 12 hours in August. One Core lasts about 28 hours in January. Two Cores last about 18 hours in August. The suggested number of Cores is 2 Cores. Two Cores cover 49% of past 12-hour-plus outage hours. Base confirms sizing at install.
